background: Use case: horizontal outpainting and clean-background reconstruction. Edit target: the provided original NIGHTBLOOM FORSAKEN HARBOR fighting stage. Create a continuous DOUBLE-WIDTH panoramic background, requested 32:9 aspect ratio (2560x720), by adding coherent scenery to the left and right, not stretching the reference. Preserve its detailed gothic pixel-art style, palette and identity: one red moon, blue misty haunted harbor, distant cliff castle and lighthouse, wrecked ships, wooden warehouses and the overhead crane. Keep the original landmarks near the central half with no duplicated moon, sun, tower or main landmark. Extend side scenery naturally at the same object scale. The wet dark timber dock planks with blue and crimson reflected lantern light must be flat, unobstructed and continuous across the entire panorama, with the scenery-to-floor horizon forming a level line around 64 percent of the full generated canvas height and the whole lower 36 percent being empty walkable floor. Remove these objects from this clean plate and reconstruct what was hidden behind them: the closest barrels, low rope-wrapped dock bollards and front ropes, bottom-edge crates/debris and the loose lantern on the fighting floor. No near props left on the fighting floor. Side architectural walls or terrain end at the horizon; nothing protrudes down into the lower floor band. No foreground border objects; these will be separate transparent layers. No fighters, people, text, labels, borders or duplicate landmarks. One richly detailed super-wide panorama.
props: Use case: background-extraction for layered game scenery. Reference/edit target is the provided original NIGHTBLOOM FORSAKEN HARBOR stage. Create a single FULL-FRAME 16:9 transparent PNG depth-props sheet matching its exact gothic pixel-art style and palette. Preserve the canvas rather than cropping tightly. This sheet has TWO SEPARATE VERTICAL ZONES with true transparency between them: (1) GROUNDED MID PROPS: small groups of near barrels, rope-wrapped bollards and lanterns at the left and right edges, no rope across the middle, each kept in its side edge 0-22 percent or 78-100 percent of canvas width, with every base ending on the SAME horizontal line at 74 percent canvas height. Keep the central 56 percent clear. Do not include a wall, floor, ground shadow slab or connecting railing. (2) VERY LOW FOREGROUND BORDER: low coiled ropes, a few broken plank ends and dark flowers at the extreme bottom corners, touching the bottom canvas edge, only within the bottom 15 percent of the canvas. The area between 75 and 85 percent canvas height is completely transparent, separating the two zones. Everything else is transparent: no sky, background architecture, floor, backdrop, mountains or scenery. No horizon strip, solid rectangle, people, text, checkerboard painted into the artwork, or extra landmarks. Props at original scale, low foreground avoids character bodies. Actual alpha transparency. Single 16:9 full-frame image.
